paragraphs: Despite offering top-of-the-line products and services—and having a long list of happy customers—many Tampa, FL area businesses still find themselves barely making it.

text: Business plan writing and planning support for starting and running a business.

body.text: Whether you own a manufacturing facility in Tampa, a medical office in Clearwater, or a real estate firm in St Petersburg, the business consultants from Reliance Consulting, LLC can implement time-tested strategies that have been proven to turn stressed companies into flourishing businesses.

slots.title: What a Reliance business consultant does

items.text: Gains intimate knowledge of the business in both its operations and finances
Provides an objective analysis of the business
Can get you started on the right foot with new business planning
Develops long term and short term business plans
Provides the company with business tax services and strategies
Brainstorms strategies to increase revenues and decrease expenses
Advises clients on marketing and networking strategies that have worked in their industries
Assists with bookkeeping, payroll, cash flow management, business finance consulting, and the other critical, day-to-day financial needs of the business

cards.title: Physicians and Healthcare
text: Accounting and tax services for doctors, dentists, clinics and other health care providers.

cards.title: Retail
text: Accounting for retail stores: point-of-sale advice, inventory tracking, sales tax and payroll.

cards.title: Restaurants and Hotels
text: Accounting and tax services for restaurants and hotels.

cards.title: Real Estate
text: Tax and accounting for real estate investors and professionals.
